methods.label: Follow the placement clues
methods.explanation:
Start with Marta's known finishing place and follow the clues connecting her to the other runners. A runner ahead has a smaller place number, while a runner behind has a larger one.

Marta finished one place behind Jack, so Jack finished \(6-1=5\)th. Jack finished two places behind Todd, so Todd finished \(5-2=3\)rd. Todd finished one place behind Rand, so Rand finished \(3-1=2\)nd.

Rand was six places ahead of Hikmet, which puts Hikmet in \(2+6=8\)th place. David then finished \(8+2=10\)th, consistent with the remaining clue. All six named runners have distinct places within the twelve-person race.

Thus the runner in eighth place was \(\boxed{\text{Hikmet}}\), choice B.
